bounding: Every corporate entity named as a person with significant control in the Companies House PSC snapshot of 2026-08-22 (all 32 parts), whose filed registration number normalises to a UK company number. EXCLUDES individual PSCs, which the register does not identify stably enough to count across companies, and excludes super-secure PSCs. Complete within that boundary; no filter on size, sector or notability.
